ننزاح (form VII)
# نَنْزَاحُ (nanzāḥu) /nan.zaː.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْزَاحَ (inzāḥa)
# نَنْزَاحَ (nanzāḥa) /nan.zaː.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْزَاحَ (inzāḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
